name: Test dependent packages

# based on https://github.com/SciML/SciMLBase.jl/blob/master/.github/workflows/Downstream.yml, thanks!

# this is the same as Test.yml
on:
    workflow_dispatch:
    push:
        paths-ignore:
            - 'frontend/**'
            - 'frontend-bundler/**'
            - 'frontend-dist/**'
            - 'frontend-dist-offline/**'
            - 'test/frontend/**'
            - '**.md'
        branches:
            - main
    pull_request:
        paths-ignore:
            - 'frontend/**'
            - 'frontend-bundler/**'
            - 'frontend-dist/**'
            - 'frontend-dist-offline/**'
            - 'test/frontend/**'
            - '**.md'
        branches-ignore:
            - release

env:
    JULIA_PLUTO_IGNORE_CDN_BUNDLE_WARNING: true

jobs:
    test:
        name: ${{ matrix.package.repo }}
        runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
        timeout-minutes: 15

        strategy:
            fail-fast: false
            matrix:
                julia-version: ["1"]
                os: [ubuntu-latest]
                package:
                    - { user: JuliaPluto, repo: PlutoSliderServer.jl }

        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v7
            - uses: julia-actions/setup-julia@v3
              with:
                  version: ${{ matrix.julia-version }}
                  arch: x64
            - uses: julia-actions/julia-buildpkg@v1
            - name: Clone Downstream
              uses: actions/checkout@v7
              with:
                  repository: ${{ matrix.package.user }}/${{ matrix.package.repo }}
                  path: downstream
            - name: Load this and run the downstream tests
              shell: julia --project=downstream {0}
              run: |
                  using Pkg
                  try
                    # force it to use this PR's version of the package
                    Pkg.develop(PackageSpec(path="."))  # resolver may fail with main deps
                    Pkg.update()
                    Pkg.test()  # resolver may fail with test time deps 
                  catch err
                    err isa Pkg.Resolve.ResolverError || rethrow()
                    # If we can't resolve that means this is incompatible by SemVer and this is fine
                    # It means we marked this as a breaking change, so we don't need to worry about
                    # Mistakenly introducing a breaking change, as we have intentionally made one

                    @info "Not compatible with this release. No problem." exception=err
                    exit(0)  # Exit immediately, as a success
                  end

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
